Genuinely great game, it may use unoriginal assets but they make full use of the assets and to be honest I think it works out.
I think it needs a bit more polish for some of the items and skills but honestly? It's worth giving a shot. I'm having a lot of fun with this game.
Clunky and awkward, it just doesn't feel good to play.

Short Disclaimer: I played this game for roughly 15 hours on console before.
It tries to be like Warframe or Gears of War but stripped off everything. Its just not fun at this point to be honest. 

A few things I found extremely annoying while playing:
- movement extremely sluggish, the characters move too slow, so slow that its really a nuisance getting close to an enemy to hit them with a melee attack or moving across the arena
- the slow movement makes things even more annoying when you have to search for the flying shield enemies that shield others which do have an infinite range and are hidden somewhere in the arena at times while everyone else keeps shooting at you
- there is sometimes no way to take cover because enemies spawn all over the place and spam aoes at you which in turn stagger and kill you if you ♥♥♥♥ up just once. 
- the fov also doesnt allow to actively keep track of the ground so the markers for grenades are hard to see when a lot is happening and the player isnt looking at the ground
- way too many aoes in the later levels. grenades, dead bodies, flying grenade launchers, grounded grenade launchers, which will also stagger and can cause one touch deaths if unlucky
- the upgrades you can get at the end of a level are not too interesting nor do they change a lot on how you play. Yes of course you can increase your sprint speed with these but until you can run fast enough to actually move easily across the levels you have to be 90 mins into a run. 

The upgrades are generally one of the bigger problems.

Most of the skills or gadgets you can pick up like turrets, decoys or grenades are useless. For grenades you are not able to gather enemies at a place where you can make use of the aoe. The turrets do literally no damage (even when skills have been upgraded with nanites, although I cant even remember if they affect the turrets. If they do, its not enough). The shield drone has not enough up time and the decoy is meh at best.

Also in a rouge-like or looter shooter if an enemy drops a good weapon (in this case a machine gun) I want to pick it up and use it. Why do I need to unlock a weapon class before being able to pick it up? If that weapon class has to be unlocked, then don't allow it to drop before that. It just feels bad to see a decent weapon for once just to be told that I am not be able to pick it up.  

The arenas just look nice but are void of anything. Their only purpose is to carry the aesthetic of the game as they are badly designed arenas in the first place. There is no practical use behind them from a players perspective. No cover, no drops or upgrades, no items to pick up, nothing aside from a few destructables which work more in your enemies favor than yours as they are ANOTHER aoe that can ♥♥♥♥ you up. At this point just throw the player into a purple box with some rain and reflections on the ground and call it a day.

It might be that some of these points are fixed with fully maxed out stats but I don't think I will be able to slug through the game to max out anything.

2/10 I will refund it here, even for early access its just void of anything substantial.

ladies and gentlemen.. I have no idea how to start to complain about this so I just try to write down whats good :)
It's colorful! Those small and pretty one directional super duper dead levels wont excite you to much and there are no surprises overwhelming you with to many impressions.. 
There are different types of enemies and weapons and its roguelike, so IF you like the gameloop and the points I mentioned earlier it must be really sweet and enjoyable cause you have to do it over and over again, knowing there wont happend new stuff it's just getting harder over time.

I really felt nothing in this game and I tried it more than one time and have over 5 hours of gameplay in this. I kinda like the optics of the levels but the rest is ugly. That would be acceptable if the gameplay rocks or theres some kind of atmosphere.. but this is stiff and dead in both cases. 

01/10
